title: One-Shape Loop
style: One rounded shape on a pale ground, the indigo accent, a soft floor shadow and a cursor. Springs only (kit track with loop=480) so the last frame flows into the first.
learnsFrom: UI-morph loops: a single element that becomes every state of an interaction.

story.what: a 'Schedule' pill button breathes; a cursor glides in and presses it (scale dips, a ripple)
the pill collapses into a circle and becomes a spinner (an arc chasing itself)
the spinner closes into a solid circle and a check draws itself
the circle stretches into a card: 'Thu 3:00 · Booked' with a small calendar glyph
the card folds back into the pill; the cursor leaves: frame 479 flows into frame 0

sizes: Square is primary. Landscape keeps the shape centred and adds the state name in small mono to the left and a four-dot state indicator to the right.
sound: beatScore soft with loop:true at 120 bpm (tails wrap); ticks on the press and the check.
teaches: A loop is a closed path in state space: key every property on springs, end on the first key, and prove the seam.

portable.style: One rounded shape on a pale ground, an indigo accent, a soft floor shadow and a cursor. Every property of the shape (width, height, corner radius, colour, fill) is keyed on springs, and the last key equals the first so the loop closes.
portable.sound: a soft loop at 120 bpm whose tails wrap around the end, with ticks on the press and the check.
portable.sizes: the shape stays centred; the current state is named in small mono on the left and a four-dot state indicator sits on the right.
